Restructuring to refocus on higher-return assets can lift margins and ROIC.
Capacity reduction may tighten supply and improve pricing/mix.
Signals cost cuts; one-time severance could impact near-term EPS.
Mitigates revenue loss; supports utilization at remaining assets.
Addresses structurally uncompetitive asset dragging profitability.
